user.title: HelloFresh
user.description: Choose how to connect your HelloFresh account. See the [documentation]({documentation_url}) for details.

magic_link.title: HelloFresh magic link
magic_link.description: Enter the email for your HelloFresh account and choose your country. A magic link will be sent to that inbox.

magic_link_confirm.title: Confirm magic link
magic_link_confirm.description: Open the email sent to {email}, then paste the full magic link URL here (preferred). You can also paste only the code from the link.

token.title: HelloFresh tokens
token.description: Paste a valid HelloFresh access token (and refresh token if available).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure HelloFresh
reconfigure.description: Update your email or country. A new magic link will be sent to complete the change.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate HelloFresh
reauth_confirm.description: The stored tokens for {email} are no longer valid. Confirm your email and country to receive a new magic link.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Check the magic link, code, or tokens and try again.
error.invalid_auth_input: Provide either a magic link URL or a code from the email.

abort.already_configured: This HelloFresh account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The authenticated account does not match this config entry.

init.title: HelloFresh options
init.description: Customize how often account data is refreshed.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to refresh data from HelloFresh (0.25 to 24 hours)

update_failed.message: Failed to update data from HelloFresh.

service_auth_failed.message: HelloFresh authentication failed for this service call.

service_recipe_failed.message: Unable to fetch the requested recipe.

service_entry_not_found.message: The specified HelloFresh config entry was not found.

service_no_entries.message: No HelloFresh config entries are loaded.

service_multiple_entries.message: Multiple HelloFresh accounts are configured. Provide config_entry_id.

service_entry_not_ready.message: The HelloFresh config entry is not ready.

get_recipe.name: Get recipe
get_recipe.description: Fetch full HelloFresh recipe details by recipe id.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional config entry when multiple accounts are configured

search_recipes.name: Search recipes
search_recipes.description: Search the HelloFresh recipe catalog by keyword.

take.name: Take
take.description: Maximum number of recipes to return

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Optional config entry when multiple accounts are configured
